scope: Synchronous physical adapter only. After the successful genuine RTE format7 format-word read, SSW and CT/CM effective-address payload reads load internal state. A physical bus failure in this phase halts without further accesses or state rollback, regardless of whether the failed transfer completion is known. No transfer is retried.
boundary: Initial SR/PC/format reads remain outside the bounded internal-load phase. This does not qualify all hardware residency/MMU/pipeline cases. Format1 bank switching uses the genuine body; no extra reads are added.
unwind: The BusFault captures the phase before instruction-unwind clears it. Normal handler return clears the phase before subsequent trace delivery. Unsupported FPU/combined CT-CM capability checks remain separate terminal limits.
halt: Interrupts including level7 are rejected before any bus/register changes while halted. Only reset clears the latch; ordinary run/state import cannot restart. Explicit exception entry, including the existing C API, also stops before any memory/state changes.
